Returns IDs, revisions, complete signed splits, receipt metadata and recurrence. Date bounds are inclusive device-calendar days. keep.description: Version explicitly chosen after reviewing both.

tools.name: open_view
tools.description: Navigate the Finances UI so the user can inspect results. Does not modify financial records. Refuses to navigate away from an open editor/dialog. view=register can select journal/account/transaction and apply text/date filters; view=overview shows reports. Does not silently change other tools' explicit target IDs.

journal.description: Journal UUID or exact case-insensitive name; ambiguous matches return candidate IDs.

account.description: Account UUID or exact case-insensitive name; ambiguous matches return candidate IDs.

transaction.description: Transaction UUID from list_transactions or get_transaction. Payees and notes are not unique identifiers.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring across payee, note, reference number, and posting account names.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD (browser timezone) or ISO 8601 with Z/offset. No relative dates.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD (browser timezone) or ISO 8601 with Z/offset. No relative dates.
